---
name: Feature request
about: A proposed extension to the instrument, its interaction model, or its archive.
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## What it is

One paragraph.

## Why it belongs in The Emotion Spectrum

Explain the creative or technical reason, not just "would be useful".

## How it fits the current architecture

Where would it live? (data model, synth, controller, visualiser, docs, deployment)

## Trade-offs

What does it cost in terms of interface, audio, deterministic behaviour, or conceptual clarity?

## Check if it is already documented

See [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) before opening a request.
